0.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_000
0.description: Pshhh... Shkohhh... Here for beastfacts? You can count on me.

23.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_010
23.description: From those that meatmunch to those that grassmunch, beastkin are as varied as they are plentiful. They can be just as happy walking the wilds as they can nesthoming alongside people.

24.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_011
24.description: Generally, they're groundwalkers. Also, beastkin don't hatch from eggs, but lifebirth much like people do.

25.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_012
25.description: So you and your Cu Sith have more in common than you might have dreamthought! Both beastkin in your own ways.

26.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_015
26.description: Flora that move by their own thinkfeels are generally classified as seedkin.

27.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_016
27.description: But be warned: seedkin can easily blend into the safeleaves. Before you know it, you've been ensnared by sprigtraps or made host to sporespurts...so tread softly and carry a big axe!

28.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_020
28.description: Bugs, basically. Flybugs, hardbugs, popotobugs. The important part is that vilekin begin as larvae and formchange into something completely different.

29.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_021
29.description: My girl Chewchum Popoto is vilekin, you know! She may look clumsythick, but she can diveswim through sand or water as quick as you please. It's all about the jiggleshake, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. That's the secret.

30.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_025
30.description: Where there's water, you'll find them─in oceans, rivers, lakes, streams, dubious puddles, and more. From fish to amphibians, so long as they can livebreathe underwater, they're wavekin.

31.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_026
31.description: Adventurers most often encounter those that float to the surface, buoyed by their own bloat. Wavekin that seek prey on land won't exclude you from a knockfight, so keep your thinkgut about you.

32.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_030
32.description: Cloudkin are oddnamed no matter how you think about it... Some <hex:021A020203>do<hex:021A020103> nesthome in clouds, but some don't, despite having wings.

33.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_031
33.description: You might call them all birds, but then there are fish that soarfly in the Sea of Clouds... Like I said: <hex:021A020203>oddnamed<hex:021A020103>.

34.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_035
34.description: These beastfriends often hatch from eggs and include lizards, snakes, turtles, and your occasional ancient creature of lore. The deciding factor is plateskin.

35.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_036
35.description: Most scalekin are groundwalkers, but others soarfly and diveswim, which is why they have subclasses of cloudkin or wavekin, respectively. Then there are those that heedcall to dragons...but so it goes with distant relations, I suppose.

36.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_040
36.description: Having a braincase clever enough to trade tongueflaps and be understood by others is all the qualification you need to be spoken.

37.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_041
37.description: ...Which means both you and I are officially beastfriends!

38.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_042
38.description: But spoken also teach us the futility of tongueflaps─language doesn't guarantee harmony. Some see communication as a skilltool of the hunt, so take care sweetwords don't lure you to your doom.

39.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_045
39.description: Metallic slabhunks and gearspin dollpuppets. At first, they were lumped into bestiaries as magical creatures, but scholars later realized forgekin were a classification all their own.

40.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_046
40.description: Whether they are weapons activated by another, or ancient machines that move according to datareads, the metal ones are forgekin.

41.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_047
41.description: The conundrum lies in those imbued with magicks or aether-rich cores. When does a machine stop being a machine? Even brightminds of today don't have a clear answer...

42.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_050
42.description: In the simplest plainspeak, ashkin are proof of scaryboos! Walking corpses, wanderlost spirits, zombies, onibi...just the barest look makes you a trembleleaf!

43.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_051
43.description: ...Or so I thought before I properly filled my braincase. Now I know these beastfriends have simply transcended death, so it stands to reason their aether and thinkfeels would be different. Before judging appearances, I suggest you lookcheck a mirror.

44.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_055
44.description: Breathe aether into something inorganic─earthrock, carvestone, puppetdolls─and you'll see it begin to move.

45.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_056
45.description: Soulkin are given lifebirth by environmental changes, waxing aetheric fluctuations, or practitioners that create them.

46.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_057
46.description: The problem is, sometimes beastfriends only <hex:021A020203>look<hex:021A020103> inorganic, and you can't just <hex:021A020203>ask<hex:021A020103> if they're organic or not. Classification is helpful, but clearly imperfect...

47.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_060
47.description: Why ask me? You're the more traveled adventurer─you probably have more keenthoughts on voidsent than I do.

48.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_061
48.description: All I know is that they come from the void─obviously─through some rentrift or man-made gate, and are incredibly dangerous upon arrival.

49.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_062
49.description: Some folks make pacts with these creatures like you might a beastfriend, but that's the stuff of sorcery. We beastmasters should leave such trickfeats well alone.

50.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_065
50.description: The closest you can come to pure aether. A given aetheric affinity shapeforms into sprites, whereas apas and analas are a bit more complicated.

51.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_066
51.description: Crystalline creatures and familiars of certain magickmakers are also considered elementals. ...Take care you don't try to snatchsteal anyone's beastfriend.

52.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_070
52.description: Mixmatching is good when building a team, but when you're building a <hex:021A020203>beastfriend<hex:021A020103>... Well, the Allagans had their own ideas, and those led to chimeras.

53.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_071
53.description: What scholars once thought were natural creatures, they later discovered to be beings knitstitched by mankind. They were made for all uses, from warbeasts to homebeasts. Forced to serve...

54.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_072
54.description: Those sorts of stories heartcrush me. Some even come from my own kin. Have you heard of the goblin engineers who knitstitched one of their own into a beastfriend? Horrible... Just...horrible.

55.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_080
55.description: Every species is made of plainbeasts and rarebeasts. Plainbeasts are more common. Clearly.

56.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_081
56.description: Therefore, it's better to notejot your bestiary with details on plainbeasts.

57.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_082
57.description: Rarebeasts may be of the same species, but something about them looks different. They may have a special colorshine or oddfronds or some such thing.

58.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_083
58.description: Some beastmasters glamour their beastfriends to take on the appearance of rarebeasts, but that's a decision you can only make together. Without your beastfriend's trust, the magicks won't take. Strange, but true.

59.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_SYSTEM_000_084
59.description: Regardless of whether you capture a subspecies, the familiar you summon will take the appearance of its basic species.

60.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_SYSTEM_000_085
60.description: Once a familiar has attained beast rank 25 within the Crucible of the Unbroken, you will be able to glamour it to resemble a subspecies. Appearances may be adjusted via the Master's Bestiary.

61.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_100
61.description: Mankind and beastfriends have worked together since time immemorial, so no one knows for sure when and how today's “beastmasters” came to be.

62.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_101
62.description: Some are more famous than others─griffin breeders in Ala Mhigo, for instance, or warriors from the former Republic of Landis. Each tradition of beastmastery is different, and many bloomthrive to this day.

63.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_102
63.description: Our tradition began with beastmasters who befriended enormous toads called Kornago. Or so they say!

64.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_103
64.description: What we value most is the kinbonds we forge with beastfriends.

65.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_104
65.description: Which is why we don't tightbind them. Battlehorns may call them when we need them, but in the meantime, our beastfriends freelive where and how they please.

66.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_105
66.description: Happy beastfriends are fitter for knockfights, and the trust you give will be returned in kind. Mutual respect is crucial for teamwork.

67.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_106
67.description: Your beastfriends' well-being is far more important than your ego. Painhurt awaits if I discover you've been mistreating them!

68.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_110
68.description: A skilled beastmaster keeps a tidy bestiary. Classifications, habitats, skills, and strengths─notejot anything and everything that may help in a knockfight.

69.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_111
69.description: Not only is notejotting a joy in itself, you need to be familiar with your familiars, and no braincase is large enough to hold every detail.

70.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_112
70.description: Your bestiary can also serve as reference when attuning battlehorns to call beastfriends. Better to simplify the process with a quick notejot than be mindtricked by a simple task.

71.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_120
71.description: Pshhh... Rely on me for what beastfacts you need. I'm determined to fill my braincase to the brim!

72.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_125
72.description: Shkohhh... You've surpassed me, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. There! Have your tongueflaps! ...You earned them.

73.name: TEXT_CTSETCXBMLOOSEFROXTALK_00992_LOOSEFROX_000_126
73.description: Wiseteach believed you would become a mighty beastmaster, and so you have. ...Although, whether you've surpassed <hex:021A020203>him<hex:021A020103> remains to be seen, doesn't it?
